description: Defines Kubernetes coordination API types related to lease objects, including Lease, LeaseSpec, LeaseList, LeaseCandidate, and LeaseCandidateList, used for leader election and coordination.

classes.name: Lease
classes.description: Represents a lease object used for leader election coordination.

classes.name: LeaseSpec
classes.description: Specifies the details of a Lease, including holder identity, timing, and strategy.

classes.name: LeaseCandidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate for a Lease, used in leader election.

classes.name: LeaseCandidateSpec
classes.description: Specifies the details of a LeaseCandidate, including lease name, versions, and strategy.
